verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both are unusable. The background is a heavily upscaled, blurry crop of the skyline. The translucent panel that held the text is gone, so all the type sits on a busy image. 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' is tiny and sits below and to the right of 'London', which breaks the reading order. 'Save your money, enjoy your weekend' is tiny, low-contrast italic jammed into the right edge. The two arrow groups are mashed into one colliding row of six chevrons, and the dark arrows are lost against the image. There is no clear hierarchy and nothing shares an edge or axis.
